title: CPUFreq Governors
description: Selects CPU frequency governors: performance, powersave, ondemand, schedutil. Each trades responsiveness for power differently; schedutil uses scheduler data for the fastest accurate decisions. The governor is the policy knob.
key_mechanisms: Pick the governor for the goal

demo.title: Demo — CPUFreq Governors

title: P-State Tables
description: Programs ACPI P-state tables mapping frequencies to voltages and power. The OS picks states; hardware enforces the voltage. Correct tables are firmware's job; the OS trusts them.

demo.title: Demo — P-State Tables

title: Operating Performance Points
description: Defines OPP voltage-frequency pairs on ARM SoCs for DVFS. Each OPP is a validated stable point; the DVFS driver switches between them. It is the ARM equivalent of P-states.

demo.title: Demo — Operating Performance Points

title: Voltage-Frequency Curves
description: Characterizes each chip's voltage-frequency curve for safe undervolting. Silicon varies; per-chip curves find the minimum stable voltage per frequency. It cuts power with no performance loss.

demo.title: Demo — Voltage-Frequency Curves

title: Workload Characterization
description: Characterizes workloads as CPU-bound, memory-bound, or idle to pick frequencies. Memory-bound work gains nothing from max frequency; characterization saves the watts. PMCs reveal the true bottleneck.

demo.title: Demo — Workload Characterization

title: Thermal-Coupled Scaling
description: Caps frequency by temperature in addition to load, preventing thermal runaway. The thermal governor overrides the performance governor when hot. It is the safety layer under DVFS.

demo.title: Demo — Thermal-Coupled Scaling

title: Per-Cluster Scaling
description: Scales big and little clusters independently on heterogeneous SoCs. Little cores sip power for background work; big cores burst for interaction. Independent rails make it possible.

demo.title: Demo — Per-Cluster Scaling

title: Latency Impact Measurement
description: Measures how frequency scaling affects tail latency, not just throughput. Powersave governors can wreck p99; measurement quantifies the tradeoff. Latency-sensitive services need the data.

demo.title: Demo — Latency Impact Measurement

title: Boost Algorithms
description: Implements opportunistic boost above base frequency within power and thermal budgets. Turbo Boost and Precision Boost exploit headroom automatically; the algorithm balances the budget across cores. It is free performance when cooled.

demo.title: Demo — Boost Algorithms

title: DVFS Profiling Harnesses
description: Profiles applications across the full frequency range to build power-performance curves. The harness sweeps frequencies while running the workload, recording time and energy. Curves drive policy decisions.

demo.title: Demo — DVFS Profiling Harnesses

title: Energy-Delay Product
description: Optimizes the energy-delay product instead of raw speed or raw power. EDP balances both; the minimum-EDP frequency is usually mid-range. It is the principled objective for DVFS policy.
key_mechanisms: Measure energy and delay per frequency

demo.title: Demo — Energy-Delay Product

title: Race-to-Idle Policy
description: Races to idle at max frequency then sleeps deep, when static power dominates. Finishing fast lets the system reach deep C-states sooner; it beats dawdling at low frequency. The policy depends on the power curve.

demo.title: Demo — Race-to-Idle Policy

title: Frequency Transition Latency
description: Accounts for the latency of frequency transitions in governor design. Voltage changes take microseconds to milliseconds; too-aggressive switching wastes the savings. Hardware with fast transitions enables finer control.

demo.title: Demo — Frequency Transition Latency

title: GPU Clock Scaling
description: Scales GPU clocks with utilization like CPUs. Graphics and compute workloads vary wildly; dynamic clocks match power to demand. Driver policies expose the knob.

demo.title: Demo — GPU Clock Scaling

title: DVFS Validation Suites
description: Validates DVFS correctness: no crashes at any OPP, correct transitions, sane power. The suite sweeps states under load and checks stability. Shipping DVFS without validation invites field failures.

demo.title: Demo — DVFS Validation Suites
